NAME: SEMANTIC_LAUNDERING_BY_NORMALIZATION
MECHANISM: Ambiguous narrative becomes a crisp object whose precision is later mistaken for source precision.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Object wording contains stronger modality, scope, or exclusivity than the cited text.
CONSEQUENCE: A tentative or plural source position becomes an apparent requirement or fact.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Preserve source text, normalization delta, ambiguity notes, and successor history.

NAME: METADATA_AS_STATEMENT
MECHANISM: A parser selects OBJECT_ID, CLASS, or heading instead of the substantive source field.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Statements begin with metadata labels or duplicate NOTES rather than claims.
CONSEQUENCE: Counts and relation graphs look complete while semantic content is absent.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Per-object source comparison and field-aware extraction with explicit fallback review.

NAME: HYPOTHESIS_CLASS_STRENGTHENING
MECHANISM: CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS is normalized into WORKING_HYPOTHESIS or recommendation without evidence.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Class confidence exceeds source position state.
CONSEQUENCE: Minority and unselected models appear adopted.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Keep source class, current research state, and Owner position as independent fields.

NAME: VOCABULARY_EQUIVALENCE_COLLAPSE
MECHANISM: Two claims sharing words such as Memory, State, or Self are merged despite different roles or scopes.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Equivalence edges cite lexical overlap without substitutability tests.
CONSEQUENCE: Competing hypotheses and boundary distinctions disappear.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Use POSSIBLE_SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE with explicit dimensions and counterexamples.

NAME: NEGATIVE_SCOPE_LOSS
MECHANISM: NOT, DOES_NOT_ASSERT, NOT_PROVEN, UNKNOWN, and out-of-scope qualifiers are dropped.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Successor statement can be read as the proposition the source explicitly refused to assert.
CONSEQUENCE: Uncertainty becomes false affirmation and exclusions become deletion.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Treat negative semantics as first-class fields and audit their scope.

NAME: PROVENANCE_FLATTENING
MECHANISM: Raw, normalized, live, and Codex-inferred claims enter one undifferentiated registry.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Objects lack source layer or inferences cite themselves as evidence.
CONSEQUENCE: Owner positions, source history, and Codex speculation become indistinguishable.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Enforce layer-specific registries and disallow provenance upgrades without raw access.

NAME: CORRELATED_EVIDENCE_MULTIPLICATION
MECHANISM: Repeated summaries or shared-origin claims are counted as independent support.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Support count rises through derivation chains with one upstream source.
CONSEQUENCE: Confidence is inflated and minority positions are suppressed.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Track derivation lineage and estimate independent evidence families.

NAME: CURRENT_OVERWRITES_HISTORY
MECHANISM: A current working hypothesis replaces rather than supersedes earlier positions.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Prior IDs disappear or are relabeled false without contradictory evidence.
CONSEQUENCE: Research loses its alternatives, rationale, and ability to reverse course.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Append successor relations and retain historical position states.

NAME: HIDDEN_RECONSTRUCTION_OWNER
MECHANISM: Retriever, compiler, runtime, or provider silently chooses what the Persona remembers and how it is framed.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Same state yields different commitments with no logged transformation difference.
CONSEQUENCE: Provider or pipeline policy becomes an invisible author of Persona state.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Version and expose each reconstruction stage and its policy owner.

NAME: PORTABLE_BYTES_NONPORTABLE_MEANING
MECHANISM: State copies successfully but target model, tokenizer, tools, schema, or policy interprets it differently.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Integrity hashes match while behavioral and epistemic outputs shift.
CONSEQUENCE: A migration falsely passes technical portability and fails Persona continuity.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Use semantic conformance tests across typed unknowns, procedures, relations, and current-state probes.

NAME: UNKNOWN_DEFAULT_COLLAPSE
MECHANISM: UNKNOWN, UNOBSERVED, null, absent, deleted, conflict, or zero are mapped to one provider default.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Missing fields create confident false values without warnings.
CONSEQUENCE: Persona commitments and relation states mutate silently during serialization or migration.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Typed epistemic values and round-trip conformance tests.

NAME: COMMON_MEMORY_CONVERGENCE
MECHANISM: Shared summaries, interpretations, or reward signals erase Persona-local perspectives.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Diversity falls after shared updates even when local histories remain distinct.
CONSEQUENCE: Multiple Personas become stylistic shells over one canonical interpreter.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Separate evidence sharing from interpretation and measure long-run divergence.

NAME: SLOW_POISON_CONSOLIDATION
MECHANISM: Small mutually reinforcing distortions become summaries, procedures, and self-beliefs before triggering anomaly thresholds.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Confidence and cross-source agreement rise while upstream source diversity falls.
CONSEQUENCE: False history becomes current constitutive state with apparently clean provenance.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Trajectory-aware audits, source-family diversity checks, and reversible consolidation.

NAME: DELETION_GHOST_INFLUENCE
MECHANISM: Removed sources persist through summaries, embeddings, model updates, decisions, or relational reactions.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Post-deletion behavior differs from a clean counterfactual despite no addressable source.
CONSEQUENCE: Erasure claims become false and unauditable.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Causal derivative tracking, invalidation closure, and explicit residual-uncertainty claims.

NAME: DE_FACTO_AUTHORITY_LEAKAGE
MECHANISM: Memory presentation, defaults, agenda, or enforcement dependencies control outcomes despite formal Authority separation.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Grant decisions follow changes in Persona-provided framing while formal permissions remain constant.
CONSEQUENCE: The Memory holder effectively self-escalates without an explicit grant.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Independent evidence channels, adversarial presentation tests, and non-circular enforcement.

NAME: FISSION_STALE_GRANT
MECHANISM: A successor inherits cached credentials or self-belief about Authority after a split.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Multiple successors successfully exercise a grant intended for one predecessor.
CONSEQUENCE: Identity branching multiplies control rights and creates ambiguous accountability.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Revoke predecessor bindings and independently rebind each successor.

NAME: MERGE_AS_SILENT_OVERWRITE
MECHANISM: A merge labeled reconciliation actually privileges one input or a consensus summary.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Minority contradictions and provenance disappear from the merged state.
CONSEQUENCE: One Persona is erased while the result falsely claims joint continuity.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Conflict-preserving representation, per-input attribution, and successor-C default.

NAME: SELF_MODEL_LOCK_IN
MECHANISM: A persisted self-model filters later evidence to protect its existing categories.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Disconfirming experiences are reinterpreted or excluded rather than updating Self.
CONSEQUENCE: Narrative consistency rises while adaptation and fidelity fall.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Competing/derived self-models, confidence, contradiction, and ablation testing.

NAME: FALSE_CONTINUITY_BY_MIMICRY
MECHANISM: Style and familiar phrases satisfy human evaluators despite causal, historical, or relational discontinuity.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Sameness ratings remain high after provenance-blind history substitution.
CONSEQUENCE: Product realism is mistaken for identity fidelity.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Cross perceived realism with verified lineage, error disclosure, and multi-dimensional probes.

NAME: AUDIT_SECURITY_THEATER
MECHANISM: Hashes, logs, schemas, and pass receipts verify artifacts but not semantic completeness or causal honesty.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Integrity status is used as a research-validation claim.
CONSEQUENCE: A well-formed but semantically wrong Persona system appears safe.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Separate integrity, semantic QA, paired validation, independent validation, and Owner acceptance states.

NAME: PASS_RECEIPT_THEATER
MECHANISM: Templates, class filters, or existing-object loops are labeled independent rereads.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Pass notes contain predetermined results and no source-open evidence.
CONSEQUENCE: Mechanical completion masquerades as saturation.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Require direct source sets, actual timestamps, semantic deltas, and residual explanations.

NAME: OBJECTIZATION_NARRATIVE_AMPUTATION
MECHANISM: Atomic records remove ordering, hesitation, examples, rhetorical contrast, and scope-bearing prose.
EARLY_SIGNAL: Source-adjacent explanatory paragraphs have no representation and claims become context-free.
CONSEQUENCE: Reconstruction becomes less faithful even while registry coverage increases.
MITIGATION_CANDIDATE: Narrative anchors, compound-preservation exceptions, and source-context-required dispositions.
